description: NaBaLaWO₆ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnnn space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a square co-planar geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.60 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a square co-planar geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.61 Å. There are two inequivalent Ba sites. In the first Ba site, Ba is bonded to twelve O atoms to form distorted BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share faces with four equivalent LaO₆ octahedra and faces with four equivalent WO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Ba-O bond distances ranging from 2.94-3.11 Å. In the second Ba site, Ba is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are four shorter (2.68 Å) and four longer (3.00 Å) Ba-O bond lengths. La is bonded to six O atoms to form LaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent WO₆ octahedra and faces with two equivalent BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 20-24°. There are a spread of La-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.41 Å. W is bonded to six O atoms to form WO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent LaO₆ octahedra and faces with two equivalent BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 20-24°. All W-O bond lengths are 1.96 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ba, one La, and one W atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Ba, one La, and one W atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Ba, one La, and one W atom.
